prose:
The accessible opening of this New York Times essay reads Anthropic’s IPO prospectus as a cultural document about AI’s promises and risks. The writer approaches it as a human observer and copyright claimant rather than offering an investor’s financial analysis.

The rest of the piece is behind an access gate. This opening does not support conclusions about the entire filing, a recommendation to buy shares or an independently checked valuation; its subject is the rhetoric and stakes of the offering.
highlights: Essay adopts a cultural rather than financial lens
